conventions.commits: Conventional commits with feat/fix/refactor/chore/docs/test prefixes; all commits are signed (GPG); DCO required
conventions.testing: Unit tests colocated in each language module via #[cfg(test)] mod tests; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/; test patterns use parse_<lang>() helper, tree_sitter::Query::new() validation, and SemanticExtractor for defuse sites
conventions.linting: cargo clippy -- -D warnings; workspace lints enforced: undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (with test-code exemptions via cfg_attr); cargo fmt --check; cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; Option<T> for fallible queries; bounds checks on source byte ranges via get_node_text() helper; no panics in query handlers

patterns: Each language module exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &str constants
Optional handler functions: extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance
LanguageInfo struct wired in get_language_info() match arm and get_ts_language() match arm
Extension map entry in lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP array
Tree-sitter grammar crate added to workspace.dependencies in root Cargo.toml and to aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml dependencies
DEFUSE_QUERY captures identifiers with @write.* and @read.* tags for definition-use analysis
extract_inheritance walks parent nodes to find base_clause/class_interface_clause or delegation_specifiers children

constraints: tree-sitter-php crate must be 0.25.2 or compatible (available on crates.io)
PHP grammar does not have parent_class/base_classes/interfaces fields; inheritance is in base_clause and class_interface_clause child nodes
DEFUSE_QUERY is required (per AGENTS.md: all languages with semantic analysis need it)
All unsafe code requires // SAFETY: comment (clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks = deny)
No unwrap_used or expect_used outside test code (enforced via cfg_attr)
New Cargo.lock entries must be >=7 days old (bypass with SKIP_PACKAGE_AGE_CHECK=true)
Language must be registered in three places: lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP, languages/mod.rs pub mod + get_language_info() + get_ts_language()
test_coverage: Existing language modules test: element query compilation and matching (classes, functions, methods), call query matching, import extraction, inheritance extraction (extends/implements), defuse query write/read sites, edge cases (empty files, generic types, nested declarations). Swift tests cover 7 dimensions; Kotlin tests cover 17 dimensions; Java tests cover 6 dimensions. Minimum expected: 9 test functions covering element queries, inheritance, defuse sites, and edge cases.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; node types: class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, function_definition, method_declaration with name field; base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes (not fields)
library_findings.notes: Grammar defines class_declaration with fields: attributes (optional), body (required), name (required). Inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as direct children, not named fields. Functions are function_definition; methods are method_declaration inside declaration_list bodies.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter::Query, tree_sitter::QueryCursor, tree_sitter::Node, tree_sitter::Language; Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::named_child(), Node::parent(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte()
library_findings.notes: Query syntax uses @capture_name for captures and @rule_name for pattern labels. Field names must match grammar definition exactly. Queries compile at runtime via Query::new().

approaches.name: Full handler implementation with all optional functions
approaches.description: Implement php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums), CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, plus extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type, and extract_inheritance handlers. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add 15+ test functions covering all dimensions.
pros: Maximum feature parity with mature languages like Java and Kotlin
Enables full call graph and receiver-type analysis for PHP code
Comprehensive test coverage reduces regression risk
cons: Highest implementation effort (~400-500 LOC for module + tests)
Requires deep understanding of PHP grammar structure
More surface area for bugs in handler functions

approaches.name: Minimal tree-sitter-only implementation (CSS-like)
approaches.description: Implement php.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and IMPORT_QUERY; no DEFUSE_QUERY, no handler functions. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add 3-4 smoke tests for query compilation and basic matching.
pros: Sufficient for basic symbol extraction and call graph
cons: Limited semantic understanding of PHP code
Does not meet AGENTS.md requirement for DEFUSE_QUERY on semantic languages

approaches.name: Intermediate implementation with core handlers and DEFUSE_QUERY
approaches.description: Implement php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance handler. Skip extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type (set to None in LanguageInfo). Add 9-12 test functions covering element queries, inheritance, defuse sites, and edge cases.
pros: Balances feature completeness with implementation effort (~250-350 LOC)
Includes required DEFUSE_QUERY for semantic analysis
Covers most common use cases (inheritance, def-use tracking)
Follows pattern of Python and TypeScript
cons: Lacks receiver-type resolution for method analysis
No extract_function_name handler (some tools may need it)
Slightly more complex than minimal approach but less than full

recommendation: Approach 3 (Intermediate implementation with core handlers and DEFUSE_QUERY). Rationale: AGENTS.md explicitly requires DEFUSE_QUERY for semantic languages; PHP is a semantic language with classes, methods, and local variables. The intermediate approach delivers the required DEFUSE_QUERY plus extract_inheritance (needed for class hierarchy analysis) while deferring the receiver-type handlers (less critical for initial PHP support). This balances completeness, effort, and maintainability. The pattern mirrors Python and TypeScript, which are well-established in the codebase. Test coverage of 9-12 functions ensures regression detection without excessive overhead.

inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (common/define-grammar.js and php/src/node-types.json): class_declaration node has three fields (attributes, body, name) but no parent_class or interfaces field. Instead, base_clause and class_interface_clause appear as direct children of class_declaration (not named fields). To extract inheritance: (1) iterate class_declaration.child() to find base_clause node; (2) iterate base_clause.named_child() to extract name nodes (each name is an extends target); (3) iterate class_declaration.child() to find class_interface_clause node; (4) iterate class_interface_clause.named_child() to extract name nodes (each name is an implements target). The grammar rule is: class_declaration = seq(optional(attributes), repeat(modifier), 'class', field('name', name), optional(base_clause), optional(class_interface_clause), field('body', declaration_list)).
